root_cause.text: In xe_reg_sr_add(), the dynamically allocated register entry (pentry) is not freed when xa_store() fails, causing a memory leak on the error path.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a `goto fail_free;` after detecting an error from `xa_store()`, and defines a new `fail_free:` label that calls `kfree(pentry)` before the existing error-reporting `fail:` label. The commit message states: "Free the newly allocated entry when xa_store() fails to avoid a memory leak on the error path."
